name: Netlify
subtitle: Web platform for static and serverless sites
creator: Mathias Biilmann and Christian Bach
description: Git-based continuous deployment for static and server-rendered sites, with a global CDN, serverless and edge functions, forms, deploy previews and framework adapters. Netlify's co-founder coined the term Jamstack.

languages.youWrite: netlify.toml config; functions in JS/TS or Go

concepts.explanation: Each deploy is complete, with instant rollback.
A URL for every pull request.
One usage unit across deploys, bandwidth and compute.

codeSamples.label: TOML · netlify.toml
codeSamples.code:
[build]
  command = "npm run build"
  publish = "dist"

[[redirects]]
  from = "/api/*"
  to = "/.netlify/functions/:splat"
  status = 200

pros: Great for static and Jamstack sites
Pro plan has no per-seat fees since April 2026
cons: Credit usage can be hard to predict

pricing.summary: Credit-based. Free: 300 credits/mo. Personal: $9/mo for 1,000 credits. Pro: $20/mo for 3,000 credits with unlimited team members. Enterprise: custom.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
